clauses_RV_377_067.diagnosis: the asserted 10/192 was taken from the committed RV-377-040 record and from GMI_DOMAIN_ALGEBRA_EXECUTED_V1 section 7, both of which report '10 of 192 runs (about 5 percent)'. The census receipt's own per-cell counts are 1 + 2 + 0 + 4 + 1 + 1 = 9, and a recount over its 192 raw capability values agrees: 9 of 192 = 4.6875 percent. The published pooled rate is off by one run and the published expected draw count by two draws.
clauses_RV_377_067.measured: q_pooled is 9/192 = 0.046875, NOT 10/192 = 0.052083, so 1/q = 21.3333, not 19.2. Sub-assertions: CI95 on q_pooled = (0.021655, 0.087116) IS contained in (0.02, 0.10), 1/q in (11.48, 46.18) IS within (10, 50); q_cell = 1/32, CI95 = (0.000791, 0.162171), upper end on 1/q = 1264.4 which DOES exceed 500. The clause fails on its asserted pooled rate only.

clauses_RV_377_067.diagnosis: prediction-writing error of the class protocol rules 12-14 were added for. 'The committed frontier with S3 struck out' names the wrong object: deleting S3 from a committed WINNER LIST leaves that cell empty wherever S3 was the sole occupant, which is 246 of 336 cells, so the clause could not have held however the cost correction came out. The quantity it was reaching for is the frontier RECOMPUTED over the admissible set with S3 removed; that is measured and reported as no_collateral_movement_recomputed, and is NOT used to rescue this clause.
clauses_RV_377_067.text: the corrected frontier over the 336 cells is identical, cell for cell, to the committed RV-377-041b frontier with S3 struck out; no other row's membership changes anywhere
the minimum over the registered grid of q* = D_draw/(D_draw + Delta) exceeds 0.49 in every column
at r = 0 the reuse horizon at which S3 re-enters the frontier is finite in every column and exceeds H = 10^6 in every column

corrected_cost_model.B_failed_candidates: 1/q - 1, the expected number of FAILED draws before the first admissible one (geometric law with success probability q); exactly 0 for a deterministic row (q = 1)
corrected_cost_model.D_draw: exec + upd + ver + rev of ONE complete run of the registered 16-event protocol at that (row, column, size)
corrected_cost_model.amortization: B_search is a one-time lifecycle intercept, charged like desc: it is paid once before serving begins, not per query and not per revision
corrected_cost_model.correction: C' = C + B_search, B_search = B_failed_candidates * D_draw
corrected_cost_model.registered_line: C = desc + H*exec_q + r*upd_e + r*ver_e + (r/4)*rev_e (smooth.cost, unchanged)
corrected_cost_model.source_of_terms: gmi_microscope.vm.lifecycle_vector, called on the live Machine ledger of each re-executed cell
